# officefloor/rest/api/<path>.GET.yml   (or .POST.yml, {param}.GET.yml, ...)

269	/**
270	 * A claim a person has on a sheet. {@code id} is null until the claim is first saved; {@code number}
271	 * is null unless the claim has been opened (a draft has none; a voided claim keeps it). {@code due} is the
272	 * due fixed when the claim was settled, or null while it is live (not settled, or settled with no rate).
273	 * {@code openedBy} is the user who opened the claim, or null while it is a draft. {@code stated} is whether
274	 * its person's last statement bound it to a figure, {@code statedDue} (null: n/a) — it then shows and totals
275	 * that figure, not its live one. {@code number} is sheet-wide (1, 2, ...) or, under period numbering,
276	 * within its period (P1-1, X-1). {@code corrects} is, for a correction, the number of the claim it corrects (null:
277	 * not a correction). {@code dueBy} is fixed when the claim is created: its date plus the terms of its person's
278	 * grade in force on that date; it does not change when the terms or its date change later. While PENDING the claim is not bound: it shows and totals its live figure, and is bound again
279	 * once rejected (back to OPEN) when the statement included it.
280	 */
281	public record Claim(Long id, String sheetId, long personId, BigDecimal amount, LocalDate date, String note,
282	        ClaimStatus status, String number, BigDecimal due, String openedBy, boolean stated, BigDecimal statedDue,
283	        String corrects, LocalDate dueBy) {
284	
285	    /** The same claim with another status, number, fixed due and opener. */
286	    public Claim withStatus(ClaimStatus next, String nextNumber, BigDecimal nextDue, String nextOpenedBy) {
287	        return new Claim(id, sheetId, personId, amount, date, note, next, nextNumber, nextDue, nextOpenedBy, stated,
288	                statedDue, corrects, dueBy);
289	    }
290	
291	    /** Whether the claim is a correction: a negative amount naming the settled claim it corrects. */
292	    public boolean correction() {
293	        return corrects != null;
294	    }
295	
296	    /** Whether the claim counts toward the totals: only OPEN, PENDING and SETTLED claims do. */
297	    public boolean counts() {
298	        return status.open() || status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED;
299	    }
300	
301	    /** Whether the claim counts toward the live totals when its person is held or not: a held person's open (and pending) claims do not. */
302	    public boolean counts(boolean held) {
303	        return status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED || (status.open() && !held);
304	    }
305	
306	    /** Whether a statement binds the claim now: it was stated and is not PENDING. */
307	    public boolean bound() {
308	        return stated && status != ClaimStatus.PENDING;
309	    }
310	
311	    /** Whether the claim keeps a figure whatever the rates: fixed when settled, or bound by a statement. */
312	    public boolean keepsFigure() {
313	        return due != null || (bound() && statedDue != null);
314	    }
315	
316	    /**
317	     * The claim's figure (null: n/a): the due fixed when it was settled, else the figure its statement bound
318	     * it to (not while PENDING), else its amount at the given live rate (null: none), at least the sheet's floor — a correction has
319	     * no floor. Its live figure rounds by the sheet's policy date.
320	     */
321	    public BigDecimal figure(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, Rounding rounding) {
322	        if (due != null) {
323	            return due;
324	        }
325	        if (bound()) {
326	            return statedDue;
327	        }
328	        RoundingMode mode = rounding.modeFor(this);
329	        return correction() ? due(amount, liveRate, mode) : due(amount, liveRate, floor, mode);
330	    }
331	
332	    /**
333	     * The claim's due (null: n/a): its {@link #figure figure}, plus the late charge on it while it is overdue. A
334	     * settled claim's fixed due already has the charge frozen in.
335	     */
336	    public BigDecimal due(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, LateCharge late, Rounding rounding) {
337	        BigDecimal figure = figure(liveRate, floor, rounding);
338	        return due != null || figure == null ? figure : figure.add(late.on(this, figure, rounding.modeFor(this)));
339	    }
340	
341	    /** An amount times a percent rate, divided by 100, rounded by the mode to two decimals; null with no rate. */
342	    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, RoundingMode mode) {
343	        return rate == null ? null : amount.multiply(rate).movePointLeft(2).setScale(2, mode);
344	    }
345	
346	    /** A live due: {@link #due(BigDecimal, BigDecimal, RoundingMode)}, raised to the floor; null with no rate. */
347	    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, BigDecimal floor, RoundingMode mode) {
348	        BigDecimal due = due(amount, rate, mode);
349	        return due == null || due.compareTo(floor) >= 0 ? due : floor.setScale(2);
350	    }
351	
352	    /** The audit field for the claim's number, " number=<n>", or "" when it has none. */
353	    public static String auditNumber(String number) {
354	        return number == null ? "" : " number=" + number;
355	    }

396	 * Opening gives the claim the sheet's next number; a voided claim keeps its number (it is never reused). While the
397	 * sheet's period numbering from date is set and its today is on or after it, opening instead gives the claim the next
398	 * number within the period containing its date (P1-1, P1-2, ...), or within the claims in no period (X-1, ...).
399	 * Opening records the user who opened it; that user cannot settle it (four eyes).
400	 * Settling fixes the claim's due at its person's grade's rate in force on the claim's date, raised to the sheet's floor and rounded by its policy date — or, when a statement
401	 * bound the claim, at the figure it was bound to — plus the late charge it has then, if overdue, frozen in; with no
402	 * figure it stays live. A clerk settling a claim whose due is above the sheet's clerk limit (a due of n/a is within any
403	 * limit) makes it PENDING instead, live and unfixed. Only a steward approves a PENDING claim (fixing its due at its live
404	 * figure, plus any late charge, at that moment) — not the user who opened it — or rejects it, with a reason, back to OPEN.
405	 */
406	public class ApplyClaimAction {
407	    public void apply(@PathVariable("action") String action, @RequestParam("user") String user, @Val Claim claim,
408	            @Val ClaimActionRequest request, SheetRepository sheets,
409	            PersonRepository people, RateRepository rates, SettingRepository settings, PeriodRepository periods,
410	            ClaimRepository claims, Out<ClaimAction> applied, Out<ClaimNumber> number, Out<Claim> updated) throws InvalidClaimException {
411	        ClaimAction found = ClaimAction.of(action);
412	        if (found == null) {
413	            throw new InvalidClaimException("No such claim action: " + action);
414	        }
415	        if (!found.allowedFrom(claim.status())) {
416	            throw new InvalidClaimException("A " + claim.status() + " claim cannot be " + found.to() + ".");
417	        }
418	        if (found == ClaimAction.SETTLE && user.equals(claim.openedBy())) {
419	            throw new InvalidClaimException("The user who opened a claim cannot settle it.");
420	        }
421	        if (found == ClaimAction.APPROVE && user.equals(claim.openedBy())) {
422	            throw new InvalidClaimException("The user who opened a claim cannot approve it.");
423	        }
424	        if ((found == ClaimAction.APPROVE || found == ClaimAction.REJECT)
425	                && settings.find(claim.sheetId()).roleOf(user) != Role.STEWARD) {
426	            throw new InvalidClaimException("Only a steward can " + action + " a pending claim.");
427	        }
428	        if (found == ClaimAction.REJECT && request.reason().isEmpty()) {
429	            throw new InvalidClaimException("A reason is required to reject a claim.");
430	        }
431	        BigDecimal due = found.settles() ? settledDue(claim, sheets, people, rates, settings, claims) : claim.due();
432	        if (found == ClaimAction.SETTLE && !settings.find(claim.sheetId()).maySettle(user, due)) {
433	            found = ClaimAction.PEND;
434	            due = null;
435	        }
436	        String next = switch (found) {
437	            case OPEN -> nextNumber(claim, sheets, settings, periods);
438	            default -> claim.number();
439	        };
440	        applied.set(found);
441	        number.set(new ClaimNumber(next));
442	        updated.set(claim.withStatus(found.to(), next, due, found == ClaimAction.OPEN ? user : claim.openedBy()));
443	    }

445	    private static String nextNumber(Claim claim, SheetRepository sheets, SettingRepository settings,
446	            PeriodRepository periods) {
447	        LocalDate from = settings.periodNumberingFrom(claim.sheetId());
448	        if (from == null || sheets.today(claim.sheetId()).isBefore(from)) {
449	            return String.valueOf(sheets.nextClaimNumber(claim.sheetId()));
450	        }
451	        Period period = periods.findAll(claim.sheetId()).stream().filter((p) -> p.contains(claim.date())).findFirst()
452	                .orElse(null);
453	        String prefix = period == null ? "X" : period.name();
454	        String key = period == null ? "" : period.name().toLowerCase();
455	        return prefix + "-" + sheets.nextPeriodClaimNumber(claim.sheetId(), key);
456	    }

458	    private static BigDecimal settledDue(Claim claim, SheetRepository sheets, PersonRepository people,
459	            RateRepository rates, SettingRepository settings, ClaimRepository claims) {
460	        Person person = people.find(claim.sheetId(), claim.personId());
461	        BigDecimal rate = person == null ? null
462	                : Rate.inForce(rates.findAll(claim.sheetId()), person.gradeOn(claim.date()), claim.date());
463	        LocalDate today = sheets.today(claim.sheetId());
464	        return claim.due(rate, settings.floor(claim.sheetId()), settings.lateCharge(claim.sheetId(), today),
465	                settings.rounding(claim.sheetId(), today, claims.findForPerson(claim.sheetId(), claim.personId())));
